programmes.title: Pinned-kernel reachability tournament
programmes.estimate: 2–4 weeks; one proof engineer plus one independent reproducer
programmes.hypothesis: Kernel elaboration and constructor closure identify a strict reachable image whose failures are stable under harmless presentation changes.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: Reachability depends materially on undeclared environment state or resource limits.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: A pinned Lean toolchain and a stratified sample of real declarations, synthetic edge cases and deliberately unreachable constructor trees.
controlled_variables: Vary constructor depth, arity and closure while holding the target type fixed
Blind the analyst to reachable versus adversarial cases
Repeat under pinned transparency and compact-constructor policies
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Treat the pinned Lean kernel as the detector: source text is parsed and elaborated under a recorded toolchain, imports and options, then reduced to kernel-checked declarations. The reported record is the accepted type and proof term or the smallest reproducible elaboration/kernel failure, plus resource counters. Separate parser, elaborator, kernel and timeout outcomes rather than collapsing them into success/failure.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Stratify compiler version, platform, import order, option state, namespace, reducibility attributes, heartbeat and memory limits, cache state and nondeterministic scheduling. Harmless presentation families share a cluster ID. Estimate failure rates and runtime tails by stratum; resource exhaustion is censored separately from logical unreachability.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The primary effect is categorical: a held-out declaration either has a kernel-checkable reachability witness or a stable minimal obstruction. Secondary scales are false prediction rate, witness size and runtime. The target is zero false reachable/unreachable classifications in the held-out set and byte-identical kernel outcomes across two clean pinned rebuilds.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before evaluation, choose a stratified held-out set containing each constructor depth, overflow class and environment perturbation. Size each stratum so that observing zero failures gives a one-sided 95% upper bound below the declared tolerated error rate (for tolerance p, n must satisfy 0.05^(1/n) greater than or equal to 1-p); report exact binomial bounds and bootstrap runtime tails, not a post hoc accuracy score.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Estimate reachable occupancy by stratum, then require every classifier error to reduce to a named missing constructor, environment dependency or timeout class.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Stop promotion if two pinned rebuilds disagree on any held-out declaration.

build_go_no_go.go: The toolchain, imports and resource envelope rebuild cleanly on two isolated hosts; every training witness kernel-checks; deliberately unreachable and overflow controls fail at their intended layer; and the held-out sample plus stopping rule are frozen.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Any accepted witness depends on an unrecorded option/import, clean hosts disagree, or timeout cannot be separated from logical obstruction. Repair provenance and detector typing before running the tournament.

bridge_go_no_go.go: A held-out reachability sieve predicts all outcomes and emits checkable witnesses.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Stop promotion if two pinned rebuilds disagree on any held-out declaration.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: Reachability depends materially on undeclared environment state or resource limits.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a reproducible reachability sieve for the represented formal objects and improves proof-carrying corpus maintenance.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None. This experiment can validate a formal bridge used by physical claims but cannot itself establish a physical law.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A failure localizes the dependence on environment, resources or formalization; it does not refute the informal mathematics without an independently checked translation.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: A held-out reachability sieve predicts all outcomes and emits checkable witnesses.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: Reachability depends materially on undeclared environment state or resource limits.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Rebuild the frozen corpus on a second operating system or independently provisioned host from the lockfile, then have an independent implementation verify exported kernel objects or certificates. The held-out labels and resource ceiling remain unchanged.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release source declarations, equivalence-family and held-out labels, toolchain and dependency locks, complete environment/options manifest, build logs, kernel exports, minimal failures, resource traces, analysis code and checksums sufficient for an offline clean rebuild.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Promote only the tested reachability and reproducibility statements attached to OT-033/OT-035; preserve the distinction between kernel fact and physical interpretation.
claim_status_propagation.null: Mark the affected reachability claim environment- or resource-relative and reopen its downstream formal dependants.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Record the exact disagreement stratum and forbid propagation until the kernel/resource boundary is resolved.

programmes.title: Normalization-orbit stability challenge
programmes.estimate: 4–8 weeks; proof engineer and data engineer
programmes.hypothesis: A canonical address is constant on declared equivalence orbits while retaining distinctions needed by later detectors.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: No single policy is stable across source-native families.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: The same declaration corpus expanded into equivalence families by alpha, beta, zeta, metadata, notation and definitional rewrites.
controlled_variables: Generate 20–100 semantics-preserving variants per declaration
Change normalization policy one rule at a time
Insert non-equivalent near neighbours with matched surface statistics
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Run each source-native equivalence family through the frozen parser/elaborator and a separately versioned normalizer, emitting raw syntax, elaborated term, kernel type, canonical address and every rewrite used. The detector record is the pairwise address mobility matrix annotated by kernel-checked equivalence, not the normalized string alone.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Stratify alpha, beta, zeta, notation, metadata and definitional rewrites; compiler and normalizer versions; reducibility policy; generated-name order; and source family. Count false merges and splits with cluster-correlated intervals so many variants of one declaration do not masquerade as independent evidence.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The hard safety signal is any false merge of kernel-distinct, detector-relevant objects, with target count zero. Stability is the fraction of kernel-equivalent variants retaining one address; residual false splits must be bounded per rewrite family and carry an explicit multi-chart explanation.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Freeze a held-out matrix crossing rewrite families with declaration complexity. Use exact one-sided binomial bounds for the zero-false-merge target and cluster bootstrap intervals for split rates. Include adversarial near-equivalents at a prevalence high enough that the lower 95% bound on their detection exceeds the declared safety target.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Treat normalization as a quotient experiment: measure false splits within orbits and false merges between orbits with bootstrap intervals by declaration family.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Retain a multi-chart atlas if global canonicalization requires erasing a detector-relevant distinction.

build_go_no_go.go: All rewrites have kernel certificates, the address policy is deterministic on two clean builds, adversarial non-equivalents remain separated and the held-out family structure is frozen.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The policy erases a later detector distinction, depends on generated names or import order, or lacks certified equivalence labels. Retain raw identity and a multi-chart atlas.

bridge_go_no_go.go: A preregistered policy achieves zero false merges and bounded, explained false splits on held-out families.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Retain a multi-chart atlas if global canonicalization requires erasing a detector-relevant distinction.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: No single policy is stable across source-native families.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass licenses the address policy for indexing and comparison within its declared equivalence classes.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None; canonicalization can expose stable structure but cannot turn address stability into physical ontology.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A global-policy failure establishes the need for typed local charts rather than failure of the underlying objects.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: A preregistered policy achieves zero false merges and bounded, explained false splits on held-out families.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: No single policy is stable across source-native families.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Repeat on an independently generated rewrite corpus and a second pinned compiler/normalizer build. The second run must reuse the equivalence definition and merge threshold; version-specific splits are reported as separate charts.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw/elaborated terms, kernel equivalence certificates, rewrite provenance, canonicalization code and version, all addresses, pairwise mobility matrices, family labels, held-out split, build manifests and checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Promote the canonical address only for the passed equivalence policy and point every dependent index to its versioned chart.
claim_status_propagation.null: Withdraw global canonicality, retain source-native identity and update downstream joins that used an invalid merge.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep parallel addresses and expose the unresolved equivalence class rather than selecting one representation.

programmes.title: Blind detector-fibre identification challenge
programmes.estimate: 6–10 weeks; modelling, statistics and domain-review trio
programmes.hypothesis: Adaptive detector enrichment separates mechanisms at finite cost, or exposes an exact residual equivalence class.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: A nontrivial model pair remains exactly record-equivalent.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: A benchmark mixing real declaration trees, driven-oscillator records, five-coordinate incidence records and synthetic mechanism pairs with controlled collisions.
controlled_variables: Reveal label, role, rooted depth, phase, sideband and intervention channels sequentially
Hold out complete mechanism families rather than random rows
Adversarially search for record-equivalent parameter pairs
programmes.detector_transfer_function: For each carrier, freeze the map from intervention and latent model parameters through dynamics, port coupling, bandwidth, calibration and noise to the stored record. The adaptive policy may select only from preregistered detector channels using training records; separation is evaluated on untouched interventions with the complete transfer map retained.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Use hierarchical nuisance blocks for carrier calibration, detector gain/phase, bandwidth, sampling, label permutation and shared simulator assumptions. Profile or marginalize them identically for both mechanisms. Exact algebraic collisions, local Fisher degeneracy and finite-noise overlap are reported as three different failure modes.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: For each mechanism pair report global record-space distance after nuisance optimization, the smallest efficient-Fisher singular value locally, and detector cost at first separation. A valid quotient has zero global distance on all declared interventions; a practical separation must exceed the calibrated record covariance on held-out data.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use pilot-free simulations or training strata to choose the enrichment policy, then Monte Carlo the held-out likelihood-ratio or equivalence test under the complete nuisance model. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 for each claimed separation and simultaneous error control across pairs; certify algebraic equality symbolically where the expected distance is zero.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Plot information gained per marginal cost and certify global injectivity only after interval or adversarial optimization over nuisance parameters.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Do not add more detectors when the residual equality is algebraic rather than noise-limited.

build_go_no_go.go: Every candidate channel has a calibrated transfer function and cost, known tangent-degenerate and exactly equivalent controls are recovered, the adaptive rule is frozen, and held-out interventions cover every claimed mechanism pair.
build_go_no_go.noGo: A channel is defined by the desired label, calibration differs between hypotheses, or the residual equality is already algebraic. Record the quotient instead of acquiring more of the same data.

bridge_go_no_go.go: Every declared pair is separated on held-out interventions or assigned to an explicit quotient class.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Do not add more detectors when the residual equality is algebraic rather than noise-limited.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: A nontrivial model pair remains exactly record-equivalent.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass identifies the minimal detector set needed to distinguish the declared mechanisms on each carrier.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: A new-physics branch requires a replicated record outside the union of all calibrated conventional mechanism fibres, not merely failure of one classifier.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Exact equivalence closes identification for the declared detector family; noise-limited overlap sets a sensitivity bound and leaves richer detectors open.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: Every declared pair is separated on held-out interventions or assigned to an explicit quotient class.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: A nontrivial model pair remains exactly record-equivalent.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Repeat the frozen enrichment policy on a separately generated benchmark and at least one independently calibrated physical or formal carrier. Separation must recur without adding channels selected from the replication labels.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release latent models, interventions, detector transfer maps, nuisance priors/covariances, raw records, adaptive choices and costs, held-out labels, equivalence certificates, likelihood code, random seeds and frozen decision rules.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Update the covered open topics with the minimal separating detector and its scope; never promote separation to identity of the latent mechanism.
claim_status_propagation.null: Record the exact quotient class or sensitivity ceiling and close only detector claims lying inside it.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Preserve the competing mechanisms and name the additional intervention or detector direction needed to reopen the branch.

programmes.title: Two-port positive-response cone tomography
programmes.estimate: 3–6 months on an existing microwave or transport platform
programmes.hypothesis: A source-native 2×2 response remains positive and genuinely rank two over a controlled frequency window.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: Every controlled window becomes rank one or scheme-sheared.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: A passive two-port microwave network first, followed by a common-sample particle/energy response implementation.
controlled_variables: Drive each port independently and coherently
Sweep frequency, temperature and relative phase
Change the declared source basis without refitting physics
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate complex source waves and outgoing waves with vector-network standards, de-embed cables and fixture, then convert the measured scattering matrix to the declared impedance, admittance or response convention with its reference impedance recorded. For the common-sample arm, retain raw particle/energy forces and currents and propagate electrical and thermal transfer functions before forming the 2 by 2 matrix.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly include VNA gain/phase, reference-impedance and fixture error, cable drift, port cross-talk, nonreciprocity, loss and basis transformation; add contacts, thermal leakage, clock phase and energy-current convention for the material arm. Carry correlated calibration covariance into eigenvalues and determinant with passivity-constrained and unconstrained fits shown.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The response must have a positive lower eigenvalue separated from zero after covariance and remain nonzero under allowed source congruences. No universal numerical ratio is assumed: the design effect is the minimum second-to-first eigenvalue ratio over the preregistered frequency window, measured first on standards and then forecast for the common-sample arm.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: From calibration-only data, select a window and compute the smallest detectable eigenvalue using covariance-aware simulations of rank-one and passive rank-two matrices. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject the rank-one boundary while the false passivity-violation rate remains below 5%, including the look-elsewhere correction for the frequency window.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Use covariance-aware cone projection; test whether the smaller eigenvalue remains positive after de-embedding and order-of-limits checks.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Stop physical interpretation if passivity violations exceed the calibrated systematic envelope.

build_go_no_go.go: Open, short, load/thru and synthetic rank-one controls recover their declared cones; the full source actuation matrix is calibrated; the rank-two forecast clears 90% power; and basis/energy-gauge transformations are frozen before the sample run.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Cross-talk, reference-plane uncertainty or thermal leakage is comparable to the smaller eigenvalue, or positivity depends on an unregistered convention. Retain only an instrument bound.

bridge_go_no_go.go: The second response direction survives calibration, basis and low-frequency scaling.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Stop physical interpretation if passivity violations exceed the calibrated systematic envelope.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: Every controlled window becomes rank one or scheme-sheared.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A microwave pass validates cone tomography and calibrates the method; a common-sample pass establishes operational rank two in the declared window.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None from rank two alone. Escalation needs a replicated response outside complete passive/Kubo/contact and convention models.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Rank one closes only the tested carrier/window; a passivity failure first challenges calibration or model adequacy, not positivity as an ontology.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: The second response direction survives calibration, basis and low-frequency scaling.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: Every controlled window becomes rank one or scheme-sheared.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Repeat with a second calibration kit/reference plane and a separately fabricated network; for material claims repeat on a second device and batch using the same window and rank threshold.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw complex waves or forces/currents, calibration standards, fixture and geometry files, environmental logs, de-embedding transformations, response matrices and covariance, basis/convention changes, simulations, frozen window and analysis code with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-008/OT-047 only for the measured carrier and window, distinguishing positive response, rank and any later Jordan interpretation.
claim_status_propagation.null: Record the rank-one or convention boundary and reopen only downstream claims that required the missing direction.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Leave rank unpromoted and publish the covariance eigen-direction or passivity residual causing the ambiguity.

programmes.title: Reversal-calibrated orientation lift
programmes.estimate: 6–12 months using an integrated-photonic or microwave platform
programmes.hypothesis: An oriented phase changes sign under physical reversal while even overlap and attenuation do not.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: The signal is removable by basis phase or reproduced by differential loss.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: A three-mode interferometric loop with an independently calibrated birefringent, chiral or boundary reference axis.
controlled_variables: Run forward and reversed loops
Flip the external orientation reference
Remove the reference element while preserving the loop
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Measure the full complex port transfer against an independently injected coherent phase reference, de-embed reciprocal propagation and insertion loss, and form a preregistered orientation-odd contrast from physically reversed loop order, boundary axis or chirality. Keep even overlap, attenuation and reference visibility as separate records.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly fit reference phase/gain drift, path-length and temperature drift, polarization leakage, port permutation, reciprocal and nonreciprocal phase, differential loss, fabrication asymmetry and detector nonlinearity. Share calibration covariance across forward, reversed, reference-off and loss-matched records; allow gauge rephasings explicitly.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The effect is the reversal-odd phase or dimensionless two-frequency contrast after minimization over allowed basis phases. Its forecast is carrier-specific and must exceed both the odd leakage seen in reciprocal controls and the propagated phase-reference covariance; even intensity change is not counted as orientation evidence.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use calibration and reference-off data to freeze an odd-contrast uncertainty and simulate forward/reverse pairs. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 after multiple-frequency correction to detect the forecast sign flip, while the same statistic remains null on reciprocal and loss-matched controls. Predeclare a circular-statistics test if phase wrapping is possible.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Fit even and odd channels jointly; the claimed lift is the interaction term between loop reversal and reference reversal, not a fitted absolute phase.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Reject the orientation claim if the reference cannot be calibrated without selected-state data.

build_go_no_go.go: The phase reference is observable without selected-state data, physical reversal can be performed without changing the calibrated transfer chain, reciprocal controls bound odd leakage below the forecast and the power calculation clears the declared frequencies.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The reference axis is inferred retrospectively, reversal also changes an uncontrolled port or loss, or gauge minimization removes the contrast. Do not claim an orientation lift.

bridge_go_no_go.go: The odd contrast reverses twice as predicted and is stable to gauge choice.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Reject the orientation claim if the reference cannot be calibrated without selected-state data.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: The signal is removable by basis phase or reproduced by differential loss.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a carrier-native orientation witness and a calibrated reversal protocol.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a replicated residual outside reciprocity-breaking, chirality, loss, drift and detector models may be escalated; the expected geometric sign flip is not new physics.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A removable phase or loss mimic closes the tested witness while leaving other independently referenced orientation detectors open.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: The odd contrast reverses twice as predicted and is stable to gauge choice.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: The signal is removable by basis phase or reproduced by differential loss.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Repeat on a separately routed or fabricated loop and with an independent reference-axis realization. Freeze the gauge convention, frequency pair and contrast before the replication; require both reversal operations to reproduce the sign structure.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw complex port data, phase-reference records, reversal and port maps, environmental logs, reciprocal/reference-off/loss controls, calibration covariance, de-embedding and gauge transformations, frozen contrasts and analysis code with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-003/OT-039 only to experimentally referenced orientation on this carrier; do not infer selection, fundamental chirality or a universal complex structure.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the chosen orientation observable at its measured sensitivity and identify whether gauge, loss or reference failure supplied the null.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Retain the even response and leave the orientation claim open until an independent reference separates phase from loss.

programmes.title: Three-mode projector-return and coherent-holonomy chip
programmes.estimate: 9–18 months including foundry cycle
programmes.hypothesis: The spectral projector returns after a closed control loop while the coherent frame acquires a nontrivial, order-sensitive holonomy.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: A static or non-Hermitian nuisance model predicts every record.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: Silicon-nitride or femtosecond-written waveguides implementing a dark three-mode subspace with programmable coupling path.
controlled_variables: Fabricate forward, reverse and path-order-swapped coupling profiles
Inject a tomographically complete input set
Sweep wavelength and deliberately add calibrated splitting and loss
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate the complex input-to-output scattering matrix against a bright reference arm and port standards, de-embed coupling and propagation loss, then restrict the polar-decomposed transfer to the independently reconstructed dark projector. Report projector chord distance, polar-unitary angle, log singular-value ratio and surviving unnormalised power; never normalize away the loss channel.
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly propagate input-state preparation, coherent receiver gain/phase, wavelength drift, port cross-talk, common and differential loss, residual splitting, lithographic coupling errors and path-end error. Fit geometric, static-splitting and loss-only models to the same complex data, with calibration covariance shared across forward, reverse and path-order-swapped devices.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The reference design requires adiabatic error at most 0.02, relative splitting and differential-loss budgets at most 0.05, projector closure distance at most 0.01 and endpoint error about 0.01512 rad or less. The illustrative coupled-mode witness has kappa_0 L=240, dark-power retention 0.999689, log singular-value ratio 0.01174 and phase-blind quarter-turn fidelity 0.999983; these are design targets, not fabricated-device forecasts.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before fabrication, inject the full calibrated covariance into a full-wave tolerance ensemble and require at least 90% power at one-sided alpha=0.05 to distinguish the reversed polar-unitary angle from both the static-splitting and differential-loss models while separately passing the 0.01 projector-closure and 0.05 nonunitarity budgets. For a contraction subtest, use the declared K>[z sigma/((1-m) theta_0)]^2 inequality rather than repetitions chosen after inspection.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Blindly compare geometric, static-splitting and loss models using held-out wavelengths and reversal data.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Do not fabricate until full-wave tolerancing leaves a resolvable process-matrix margin.

build_go_no_go.go: A positive-coupling, phase-assisted or two-module full-wave layout realizes kappa_0 L at least 207.7968; at least 95% of the preregistered fabrication/noise ensemble passes closure, dark-space retention, reference visibility and the 0.05 splitting/loss budgets; and the power calculation clears 90% before mask release.
build_go_no_go.noGo: No signed-effective-coupling or positive-path layout retains a nonempty robustness wedge, reference visibility is insufficient to distinguish orientation, or the tolerance ensemble fails the preregistered pass fraction. Close the passive strict-quarter-turn build and move to the fast-holonomy or actively modulated branch.

bridge_go_no_go.go: Projector closure and reversed noncommuting transport survive independent loss calibration.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Do not fabricate until full-wave tolerancing leaves a resolvable process-matrix margin.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: A static or non-Hermitian nuisance model predicts every record.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A passing device establishes programmable projector return with coherent noncommuting transport and supplies a calibrated platform for selector experiments.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None from this emulator alone. Escalation requires the same unexplained residual on an independently fabricated carrier after the complete geometric, static, loss, calibration and detector models fail.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A nuisance model spans the full record or the apparent sign disappears without the chosen reference; retain the result as a detector or control-engineering bound.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: Projector closure and reversed noncommuting transport survive independent loss calibration.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: A static or non-Hermitian nuisance model predicts every record.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Repeat the blind protocol on a second fabrication run and on at least one independently routed forward/reverse device pair. Freeze the de-embedding and reference convention on the first run; the second run must pass the same absolute budgets without refitting their thresholds.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release masks or layout parameters, measured coupling and loss calibration, raw coherent port sweeps, reference-arm records, environmental metadata, covariance estimates, de-embedding code, full-wave model, tolerance draws, blinded labels and the frozen analysis configuration under one checksum manifest.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-002 and the transport portion of OT-037 to experimentally demonstrated on this carrier; leave OT-003, fundamental symmetry and spontaneous-selection claims open.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the tested passive layout and update OT-002/OT-037 to the measured nuisance or feasibility boundary; do not propagate the null to unrelated carriers.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Retain the equivalence class in OT-001 and keep every mechanism claim unpromoted until the reference or covariance deficit is removed.

programmes.title: Selector-on/off basin tomography
programmes.estimate: 9–18 months; can share EX-006 hardware
programmes.hypothesis: A carrier-native Y changes the fixed point and contraction tangent rather than merely relabelling a preselected outcome.
programmes.strongest_conventional_null: The same contraction occurs with Y absent or after loss matching.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: The holonomy chip or modular acoustic loop extended by a separately addressable dissipative or anisotropic selector segment Y.
controlled_variables: Prepare at least twelve initial states spanning the accessible manifold
Toggle Y on/off and reverse its axis
Match total loss and cycle time across conditions
programmes.detector_transfer_function: Tomographically reconstruct the state after every cycle from calibrated complex port records, then infer the return map in a fixed carrier-native coordinate chart. Estimate its fixed point and Jacobian from all initial states together. The independently actuated Y segment has its own on/off transfer calibration and loss-matched dummy; it may not be inferred from the selected endpoint.
calibration_and_reference_channels: Y inferred only from independent calibration
programmes.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly model state-preparation error, tomography gain/phase, cycle-dependent loss, drift, saturation, finite bandwidth, uncontrolled anisotropy, leakage, Y cross-talk and coordinate-chart uncertainty. Fit selector, uniform contraction, pure-loss and pre-existing-axis alternatives to the same trajectories with shared calibration covariance.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: The primary signals are the Y-on minus Y-off fixed-point displacement and the largest transverse Jacobian eigenvalue below one. Forecast both from the calibrated carrier model; require displacement larger than the combined fixed-point covariance and contraction distinguishable from uniform attenuation across several initial states.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Simulate the complete trajectory and tomography model before running. Choose initial states and cycle count for at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject both unchanged-fixed-point and loss-only nulls, with familywise control across tangent directions. State a maximum cycle count before drift dominates and a minimum detectable basin displacement.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Fit a common generative return map with Y as a preregistered intervention and compare contraction spectra, not endpoint images alone.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Stop if Y can only be defined retrospectively from the selected state.

build_go_no_go.go: Y is independently measurable and switchable, the loss-matched dummy reproduces attenuation without the predicted axis shift, observability of the return-map Jacobian is full rank and the power study clears the chosen initial-state ensemble.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Y exists only as a retrospective fit, tomography cannot separate axis motion from loss, or the carrier implements neutral holonomy without a distinct selector. Retain the platform as a transport experiment only.

bridge_go_no_go.go: Y produces the predicted fixed-point shift and subunit tangent eigenvalue across initial states.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Stop if Y can only be defined retrospectively from the selected state.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: The same contraction occurs with Y absent or after loss matching.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass demonstrates controlled basin selection and supplies a programmable attractor or memory element.

programmes.estimate: 18–36 months across materials, transport, optics and force metrology teams

programmes.strongest_conventional_null: Optical-tail, patch, roughness or magnetic freedom spans the effect.
programmes.carrier_and_preparation: One batch of anisotropic magnetic films split into witness coupons and a force/torque device, with common growth and metrology records.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Do not proceed to force fabrication until OT-006 cross-channel prediction passes on held-out films.

Preserve the exact (2,1,-1) electroweak redistribution null when the unrestricted EFT is fitted.
programmes.predicted_signal_scale: No physical event-yield forecast is admissible before the source-complete amplitudes are computed. The pre-data design scale is algebraic: 19 of 27 templates fit the ten quadratic coefficients, nine pair-plane contrasts audit closure and eight three-source corners remain held out; a surviving second singular shape and odd interference moment must exceed their propagated theory-plus-detector uncertainty.
programmes.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: After amplitude and detector folding but before observed-data unblinding, run Asimov and toy likelihoods over the declared mass/lifetime grid. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject the weak-quotient rank-one null at the preregistered non-collinearity threshold while all eight held-out corners and Ward residuals pass. Report exclusion-only regions where sign identification lacks power.

blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.analysis: Complete every coefficient through one frozen basis, running and weak-threshold dictionary before calculating rank. Test Ward identities and the 27-setting quadratic closure at differential level; only a non-collinear surviving shape proceeds to detector folding. Use the meson likelihood as a common-EFT validation arm and profile current, gluonic, CKM, hadronic, decay and detector nuisances.
blind_or_preregistered_analysis_rule.stoppingRule: Do not claim separation from an isolated matching term, one-coupling limit or diagram subset; stop unless source completion, Ward checks, held-out prediction and the full covariance all preserve the second shape.

build_go_no_go.go: The full gauge-complete amplitude passes Ward checks, the 27-setting quadratic closure and held-out corners; a non-collinear signed shape survives detector folding; public likelihood inputs or a reproducible recast exist; and the power study clears the declared region before data unblinding.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The second shape disappears under source completion, violates Ward or held-out closure, is erased by detector folding, or no public likelihood supports the covariance. Retain the rank-one cross-scale constraint and stop the sixth-coordinate claim.

bridge_go_no_go.go: A source-complete non-collinear differential shape clears its preregistered singular-value threshold, survives detector folding and predicts the held-out meson or collider category without refitting.
bridge_go_no_go.noGo: Do not claim separation from an isolated matching term, one-coupling limit or diagram subset; stop unless source completion, Ward checks, held-out prediction and the full covariance all preserve the second shape.
bridge_go_no_go.conventionalNull: The full amplitude recombines to the weak quotient, as the MFV meson kernel does, closing the proposed sixth-coordinate route while retaining a useful cross-scale constraint.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A positive result establishes an identifiable EFT coordinate combination and a reusable source-complete collider/meson likelihood.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only observed data inconsistent with the complete seven-coordinate EFT, widths, running, hadronic and detector nuisance model and replicated in an independent channel may enter a new-physics escalation.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Failure of the second shape closes this detector route without falsifying the EFT or the broader admissibility programme.

positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.positive: A source-complete non-collinear differential shape clears its preregistered singular-value threshold, survives detector folding and predicts the held-out meson or collider category without refitting.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.null: The full amplitude recombines to the weak quotient, as the MFV meson kernel does, closing the proposed sixth-coordinate route while retaining a useful cross-scale constraint.
positive_null_ambiguous_outcome_branches.ambiguous: Hold every scientific promotion, repeat the calibration and declared controls, and report the unresolved likelihood or equivalence class rather than selecting a preferred mechanism.

programmes.replication_rule: Validate the fitted kernel on all eight held-out simulation corners, then require an independent physical category or experiment—such as a separately reconstructed charged/neutral mode or meson channel—to reproduce the inferred invariant combination with the basis and thresholds frozen.
programmes.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release model/UFO and parameter-card versions, amplitude and Ward-test code, phase-space seeds, all 27 template weights, response matrices, sideband definitions, covariance and nuisance priors, public-data identifiers, likelihood/recast code, held-out labels and frozen decision configuration under checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-048 for the declared process and constrain OT-047 with the measured invariant combination; preserve the unrestricted EFT null and do not infer ultraviolet origin labels.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the proposed sixth-coordinate detector route if source completion restores the weak quotient; retain the resulting cross-scale likelihood and exact null structure.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep OT-048 open, report whether theory, detector or public-likelihood covariance dominates, and forbid sign or rank promotion.
